justifications.durability: the guard fires and I reproduced it independently: with the _CleanupGroup.parse_args reroute removed, tests/cli/test_discover_sequence.py::test_bare_facility_routes_to_hidden_run_and_status_keeps_its_command fails (my mutation-scratch.log records 1 failed, EXIT=1), which is the reviewed run's own final-negative-control.log red reproduced. The suite also pins the failure-isolation, remaining-budget and selection behaviours by test, so a regression in any of them is visible.
justifications.evidence: I reproduced both arms independently in scratch trees of the reviewed revisions (source copied from the reviewed worktree, base source restored from the base blobs, UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT pointed at the main checkout's .venv, PYTHONPATH at the scratch tree, module.__file__ confirmed under the scratch tree): base c79ce9d3 ran the plan's command to '64 passed, 1 warning' EXIT=0 and head eb32cddb ran the same to '75 passed, 1 warning' EXIT=0, matching the reviewed run's own baseline-gate-worktree.log (64 passed) and after-suite.log (75 passed). I also reproduced the negative control independently: removing the group's run injection makes test_bare_facility_routes_to_hidden_run_and_status_keeps_its_command fail (EXIT=1). The shortfall is that the reviewed manifest omits baseline_suite, so its own record alone does not yield the added-failure count.
justifications.fit: the added symbols (STAGES, Stage, StageOutcome, SequenceOptions, probe_access, evaluate_stage, run_sequence, _report) are named by what they do with no plan label or section number, the hidden run command mirrors the _HostGroup idiom the plan names, and the frozen option dataclasses follow the six folds. A small fit shortfall is the discover_inspect threshold change, which is not the call site the plan describes.
justifications.goal_fidelity: every done-when behaviour is present and measured: the bare-facility route, ordered stage calls with shared cost/time, failure isolation with independent domains continuing, --only/--skip/--scan-only/--flush selection, the --reset-to and --scan-only+--flush refusals, the final one-row-per-domain table, and the registry review's findings (each signals half resolving to run_signals_stage, the mapping seat ids-mapping, the wiki probe over every configured site, the status threshold at get_path_scan_threshold). The shortfall is that the plan names a node fragment among its write paths and orientation_write_paths declared docs/evidence/fragments/facility-discovery-sequence/sequence-runner.html and a figures dir, and neither was produced, so the node's evidence lives only in the manifest.
justifications.reuse: the runner reuses the canonical discovery health checks, each fold's stage function and options dataclass, the existing map_run pipeline, and _run_with_receipt rather than re-deriving counts. The reuse smell is run_mapping_stage's own --focus reader (it expands a manifest of IDS names inline at sequence.py:463-473, duplicating the candidates-page focus reader the fold added), and it monkeypatches workers.run_mapping_engine globally to capture the receipt, restored in a finally.
justifications.scope_discipline: the diff touches only the three declared code/test files with no pyproject, lock or unrelated change; the declared fragment and figures dir were not produced, which is an evidence shortfall rather than scope creep. One change sits just outside the plan's named site: the plan names only the discover status call site for the path-scan gate, and discover_inspect's scored-path filter moved from get_discovery_threshold to get_path_scan_threshold in the same commit.
